comparison_notes: GPU sweeps use seeds 0,1, tiers idm,cacc for Bologna and idm,acc for I80, penetrations 0,1. Thesis reference averages three SUMO seeds.
p=0 is human in both labelled tiers. World seed includes replica index, so these provide four distinct human speed-factor realizations.
GPU identical-seed replay remains nondeterministic once congestion/collisions occur. These are individual validation sweeps, not confidence intervals.
Only the retained small source ports and ahead-only lane occupation are in the branch. Larger clock/cooperation/reservation and slot-capacity experiments were reverted.
Intermediate sweeps combine experiments; they are retained for diagnosis and are not all isolated causal comparisons.

source_evidence.finding: Lane-change dens counts already-swept vehicles ahead, not total lane occupancy.
Full occupants use cannotIgnore for stopAsap; partial occupants use sameTarget or sameSource.
isFrontOnLane means front physically on the lane, not queue leader.
CACC secure gap depends on the actual leader model.
lastUpdateTime latches on the first call even in the hysteresis band.

ring.notes: ACC and CACC speed unchanged exactly; no collisions or stuck teleports. Ahead-only occupation does not run on single-lane ring.
